Weekly Context & Takeaways

Scale-Up Milestone

This week SupDem crossed both live autoscaling thresholds: Tier 1 $100 / 2 contracts → Tier 2 $150 / 3 contracts at $4,500 → Tier 3 $200 / 4 contracts at $6,000. Current balance at recap: $6,328.74. R-normalized performance becomes increasingly important because dollar P&L now reflects changing position size.

What Carried

The best two actual trades produced +$836.40 and +$461.40. Despite a 37.5% WR, the average winner of +$350.15 was about 3.5x the average loser.

What Hurt

Ten trades lost, and the largest loss was -$164.60. That trade was also the week's Failed Winner.

Observe, Don't Optimize

Continue recording every Failed Winner and every +1R trade that subsequently becomes a large winner before changing live management.
